mode.title: What to collect
mode.description: topConcurrent = Steam's live top 100 games by players right now (+ today's peak). topDailyPeak = Steam's top 100 by yesterday's peak, with last week's rank. appsCurrent = live player count for the games you list. appHistory = player history for the games you list (monthly average/peak since launch + daily and hourly points). steamchartsTop = the long tail: up to ~12,700 games ranked by current players with 30-day peak and hours played. steamOnline = total Steam users online, last 48 hours.
enumTitles: Live player count for my games

apps.title: Games (for appsCurrent / appHistory)
apps.description: One per line: a Steam appid (730), a Steam store / SteamCharts / SteamDB app URL, or a game name (resolved through Steam store search; an exact title match wins). Only used by the appsCurrent and appHistory modes.

maxItems.title: Max results
maxItems.description: Maximum ranked games to return. The two official Steam charts stop at 100; steamchartsTop goes up to ~12,700.

minPlayers.title: Minimum players
minPlayers.description: Skip games below this many players (current players for live charts, daily peak for topDailyPeak). 0 = no filter. In steamchartsTop the run stops at the first game below the threshold, so a high value is also a cheap way to cap the run.

compareWithPrevious.title: Compare with previous run (monitoring)
compareWithPrevious.description: Remember each game's player count between runs and add previousPlayers, playersChange, playersChangePct, previousRank and rankChange. Schedule the actor (e.g. hourly) to turn it into a monitor. Snapshots are kept per mode in the named key-value store 'steam-players-monitor-snapshots'.

alertChangePct.title: Alert threshold (%)
alertChangePct.description: When comparing with the previous run, mark records whose player count moved by at least this percentage (up or down) with alert: true. 0 = off.

includeStoreDetails.title: Include game details
includeStoreDetails.description: Add name, store URL, developers, publishers, release date and the raw Steam store item. Costs one extra request per 100 games for appsCurrent; free for the two official charts.

includeSteamchartsStats.title: Add 24h peak & all-time peak (appsCurrent)
includeSteamchartsStats.description: appsCurrent only: also read SteamCharts for each game's 24-hour peak, all-time peak and last-30-days average (one extra request per game). Games SteamCharts does not track keep their live count and get steamchartsError.

includeSeries.title: Include time series points
includeSeries.description: appHistory: add every player-count point (monthly since launch, then daily, then hourly for the last ~30 days). steamOnline: add the 48-hour series at ~5-minute steps. Turn off to get only the summary.

historyDays.title: History window (days)
historyDays.description: appHistory only: keep only points and months from the last N days. 0 = full history since launch.

country.title: Store country
country.description: Two-letter country code used for game details (store URL, availability). Player counts are global and do not change with it.

language.title: Store language
language.description: Steam language name for game names and descriptions (english, german, japanese, koreana, schinese, ...).

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent requests
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel requests for per-game modes and steamchartsTop pages.

maxRetries.title: Max retries per request
maxRetries.description: Attempts per request with exponential backoff before a game is reported as an error.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Not needed: none of the Steam or SteamCharts endpoints used is blocked or rate-limited for normal volumes. Turn on Apify Proxy (Residential) only if you run very large, very frequent jobs and start seeing errors.
